bull_bear.body: The company plans to fund its capex through internal accrual and equity infusion, with a focus on maintaining a healthy financial risk profile.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Fluctuations in global supply and prices, especially in bulk chemicals and refrigerant gases, production quota restrictions, and foreign exchange risks
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: The company's move towards R-32 production to mitigate the risk of production quota restrictions in the fluorochemicals business
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Battery materials is the declared capital sink: Rs. 6,000 Cr of capex by FY28 targeted at 2x asset turnover and 25%+ EBITDA margin.
- The returns-trend slide is presented on an adjusted basis: RoCE is stated "Excluding capital employed in Capacity expansions in the last two years and Capital Work in Progress (Including EV), which will start generating revenues from next financial year"; FY26 is also flagged as including only 4 days of GFCL EV business.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Fluoropolymers: 60% of revenue (FY25), Fluorochemicals: 40% of revenue (FY25)
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Described as "a leading Indian Chemicals Company supplying fluoropolymers and fluorochemicals to the global market" and "the largest PTFE / fluoropolymer manufacturer in India"; core-competency slide calls it "India's largest integrated fluoropolymer producer and among the leading players globally".
- Part of the INOXGFL Group, described as a "USD 16 Bn Indian Conglomerate" (as on June 30, 2026; INR:USD Rs. 96) with a legacy of over nine decades and three listed entities spanning fluoropolymers, fluorochemicals, battery chemicals, wind, EPC, renewable O&M, solar and RE power generation.
- Global presence as "a key supplier of fluoropolymers and refrigerant gases worldwide, with a strong focus on the Europe, and the USA"; also cited as the "Largest R-22 producer from India" and a "Major producer of Chloroform and MDC".
- Entry barriers listed for fluoropolymers: "Technical know-how, process safety, raw-material availability, capex intensive" plus "Customer validation, approvals and qualifications, a time consuming & painstaking process"; the deck adds that fluoropolymers have "no technically viable substitutes" for their property set.
- GFCL EV is described as the "Only global company offering electrolytes salts, formulated electrolytes, cathode active materials, anode active materials and binders under one roof", with battery-agnostic offerings covering both LFP and NMC.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Group structure] GFCL EV is a battery-materials subsidiary of GFL catering to the EV/ESS ecosystem through battery salts, additives, electrolytes, CAM, cathode binders and NGAAM (anode); a separate GFL subsidiary serves the solar and green hydrogen value chain.
- [Market outlook] Ex-China Li-ion cell demand outlook shown as ~500 GWh in CY26 to ~1.8 TWh in CY30 at a ~38% implied CAGR, with LFP expected "to remain the dominant chemistry across mass-market EV & ESS" and AI/data-centre-driven electricity demand cited as a BESS driver.
- [Segment outlook] Refrigerants "demand and pricing remain stable in near term"; caustic soda demand "expected to remain stable in FY27"; "Chloromethanes performance is likely to remain range bound"; fluoropolymer "Demand momentum expected to remain healthy".
- [Supply chain] "Supply-chain localization remains a key tailwind, as customers increasingly prioritize supply security and diversified sourcing, supporting our strategic positioning."
- [Labour code] Q4FY26 PAT is stated before an exceptional item related to implementation of the new labour code of Rs. 2 crore (net of tax) in the Chemical Segment and Rs. 3 crore (net of tax) in Consolidated.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Operating margin: 27% (9M FY26), EBITDA margin: 25-27% (expected over the medium term)
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: The company expects to maintain a healthy operating margin and robust debt protection metrics, driven by growing demand in electric vehicle batteries and renewable energy. The company plans to invest Rs 1,700 crore per annum in the new fluoropolymer segment, including battery chemicals, over the next few fiscals.
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body: Growing demand in electric vehicle batteries and renewable energy, expansion into new fluoropolymer products
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd is a leading specialty chemicals company with a strong market position in fluoropolymers and fluorochemicals, and is well-positioned to benefit from growing demand in electric vehicle batteries and renewable energy. The company has a diversified product portfolio and a strong financial risk profile, with a healthy operating margin and robust debt protection metrics. However, the company's performance is susceptible to fluctuations in global supply and prices, especially in bulk chemicals and refrigerant gases.
